Name: Dr Flug replaces Harvey
Author: Flickrrrr
Description:
Replaces Harvey's sprites, portraits, and name with Dr. Flug's from the Max show, Villanos/Villainous. He also loves pancakes!

This is a Content Patcher mod, so downloading Content Patcher is required. This is my first mod, so apologies if there are any bugs or issues!

Downloads.Description: I've made an update that tweaks a bit of dialogue.
